title: 2 different materials were used in this print
text: 2 different materials were used in this print. Returned them because 2 panels were printed on 2 different materials making both the back and the front visibly different.  Really disappointing.

product_metadata.title: Flamingo P (One Panel) Blackout Room Darkening Printed Taupe Country Birds Curtain, Unlined Light Blocking Drape, Grommet Type, Thermal Insulated Feature. Polyester Soft Microfiber 96 by 52 inch
features: The Room Darkening Curtain is unlined, Sold individually
Vivid Turquoise birds on the printed drape, the pattern makes Room darkening drapery more fancy. Work efficiently in insulating heat and cold outside.
The panel features microfiber fabric and hangs with stylish vintage copper grommets. Inside Diameter of each grommet is 1.6'' and 2.3'' for outside diameter, so it will accommodate up to 1.5''rod.

These curtains are brushed for added softness and helps to block unwanted, exterior light, reduce noise, and save energy to create the ultimate sleep environment, helps darken rooms and provides additional privacy, Nursing for Nightshift workers.
Dry clean/ Machine Washable/ Mild liquid laundry detergent/ Avoid hot water and bleach/ Warm iron as desired
